column7: 2026-11-05: pysemver sort (cli.py cmd_sort) is done but uncommitted. Choices I made myself: no top-level semver.cmd_sort export, because the existing semver.cmd_* names are deprecated aliases in _deprecated.py; nargs='+' so an empty call errors instead of printing a blank line to the Jenkins 'while read' loop; changelog.d/pr505.feature.rst uses a guessed PR number, so rename it to the real one.

2026-11-05: pysemver sort now reads stdin (one per line, blanks ignored) when no args given — user request; supersedes my earlier nargs='+' choice. Uses nargs='*'; empty input prints nothing (returns None) to avoid a blank line in 'while read' loops. Invalid line is still error rc 2.

2026-11-05: pysemver latest (cmd_latest) done, uncommitted. Prints JSON {"version": "x"} per the repo rule (new subcommands = JSON). My own choices: object shape rather than bare string; reads stdin like sort when no args; no stable version -> ValueError, rc 2, nothing on stdout (not null/empty). Changelog changelog.d/pr506.feature.rst uses a guessed PR number; rename to the real one.
